question: Gastric irritation is least with following NSA1D: (PGI June 2008)
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Acetaminophen" -> "minimal COX inhibition in stomach" -> "least gastric irritation" -> 95%
analysis: Acetaminophen (paracetamol) is not classified as a traditional NSAID and is known for having minimal gastric irritation compared to other NSAIDs. While ibuprofen is noted to prevent gastric irritation in some contexts, acetaminophen is generally considered to have the least gastric irritation among the options provided, as it primarily acts as an analgesic and antipyretic without significant anti-inflammatory effects that contribute to gastric irritation.
